verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions robots.txt compliance or automatic per-site rate limiting. The related items are adjacent features that do not deliver this story: IP rotation to avoid blocking, SessionPool proxy rotation, API-client retries against Apify's own API, and a maxCrawlPages input. The axis clearly applies to a web-crawling platform, so the absence of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can configure the crawler to respect robots.txt rules and target-site rate limits automatically
